lines.2: 「It's summer vacation, so it's pretty crowded.」
lines.4: I handed Konoe her ice cream (peanut-butter flavor).
lines.5: 「Last time we came here, I was on pins and needles.」
lines.6: 「Now that we're a couple, I want to do this over and actually have fun.」
lines.7: 「Something about calling us a "couple" is embarrassing.」
lines.11: 「Are we animals!? Well, I guess humans are animals too.」
lines.14: 「Ahaha... When I think about being a couple with you, Tsushima, I get so embarrassed I feel like lying on my bed and kicking my legs.」
lines.15: 「I kind of get that, and kind of don't.」
lines.16: 「By the way, you call me all the time, but keep an eye on your phone bill, okay?」
lines.17: 「What an unromantic thing to worry about.」
lines.19: 「When I'm typing an email and adding emoticons, I just think, 'Ugh, this is taking forever. I'll call and hear your voice instead.'」
lines.20: 「Tsushima... you don't like talking on the phone?」
lines.21: 「...How do I put this? Of course I like phone calls too.」
lines.22: 「But sometimes email is nice because I can say embarrassing things more easily... I think.」
lines.27: 「I just came to my senses, and the looks people are giving us are starting to sting.」
lines.30: 「Naturally. It's basic public etiquette. Can't argue with that.」
lines.31: 「You need to control yourself a little better!」
lines.32: 「You're the one who needs to control yourself.」
lines.33: 「Don't say things that make my crest stand on end! I'm more normal than you are.」
lines.35: She flipped it open and showed me the screen.
lines.36: 「Your wallpaper... That's us dancing the folk dance at the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.」
lines.37: 「Noriko took a picture, so I had her send it to me and made it my wallpaper.」
lines.38: 「And that's as far as I go!」
lines.42: 「And don't you start saying you want some secret sign only the two of us understand, either!」
lines.46: 「Ah, but, you know... If you absolutely insist, I guess I wouldn't have a choice.」
lines.48: 「Konoe, the looks we're getting! They're getting really awkward.」
